analyst_view.overall: Early view: Lyon visit Troyes on a Sunday lunchtime between Europa League games (Lillestrom on 26 November, Union SG on 10 December), so rotation is possible but should not be heavy. Troyes (17th) have scored only seven goals all season, while Lyon have one of the best defences (9 conceded) but were beaten 2-0 at Brest before the break.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.4 goals. I lean slightly lower: Troyes score 0.7 a game and Lyon concede 0.9, and Troyes have become harder to break down (two clean sheets and a 1-0 loss at PSG before the break). A narrow Lyon win is the base case.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.3 corners. That looks fair: Lyon keep the ball (69% at Brest, with eight corners) and Troyes win a decent number of corners for a bottom side (5.7 a game per Statz). I see no reason to move it.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.3 cards. Troyes (12.3 fouls a game) and Lyon (11.6) are both close to the league average, so I stay with the site. A Troyes side chasing a result late could add one.

shots.text: The numbers say 23.2 shots, with Troyes taking more than Lyon, which looks unlikely. I lean slightly higher overall: Lyon average 12.8 shots a game and should dominate the ball, and Troyes average 13.1. I would expect Lyon to have the larger share.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.9 shots on target. Troyes (3.3 a game, 16th) and Lyon (4.6) sum to about eight, so I stay with it. Lyon's finishing was poor at Brest (two on target from 10 shots).
